definitions.short: Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines
definitions.full: H3731. Kaphtor II. כַּפְתֹּר כַּפְתּוֺר proper name, of a territory probably Crete , so Ew Kiep Di Gen 10:14 Gie Jer 47:4 and others; compare A. J. Evans Cretan Pictographs (1895), 100 ff. ; (> ᵐ5 . Syriac Version. ᵑ7 ᵑ9 . Cappadocia , certainly wrong; Mich Cyprus ; Eb AgM 127 ff. and others the coast of the Nile-Delta ; WMM As.Eu.387 f. Philistines, originally pirates from southwest coast of Asia Minor, and the Aegean islands); — כַּפְתּוֺר Amos 9:7 (original home of Philistines), כַּפְתֹּר Deut 2:23 (home of Caphtorim, see below); כַּפְתֹּר אִי שְׁאֵרִית Jer 47:4 the rest of the coast-land of Caphtor. — See also כְּרֵתִי below
